_comment: Claim Adjustment Reason Codes (CARC) knowledge base. appealable: yes/maybe/no. win_prob: rough probability an appeal/fix recovers the money when worked properly. fix: what actually gets it paid. batch: whether one root-cause fix typically unlocks many claims at once.

1.fix: Patient responsibility - not a payer denial. Out of scope (no patient collections).

4.desc: Procedure code inconsistent with modifier used
4.fix: Correct the modifier and resubmit as corrected claim.

11.fix: Verify dx/CPT pairing, correct and resubmit.

16.desc: Claim/service lacks information or has submission/billing error
16.fix: Read the RARC for the specific missing element, supply it, resubmit. Usually fast money.

18.fix: Usually a true duplicate. Only appeal if it was NOT a duplicate (e.g., two same-day sessions with modifier 76/59 missing).

22.desc: Care may be covered by another payer per coordination of benefits
22.fix: Patient's COB info is stale with the payer. Have patient update COB or submit primary EOB, then resubmit.

27.fix: Verify eligibility for DOS. If coverage was active, appeal with eligibility evidence. Else bill correct payer.

29.desc: Time limit for filing has expired
29.fix: Appeal WITH proof of timely original submission (clearinghouse acceptance report). Strong if you have the 999/277 acknowledgment.

45.desc: Charge exceeds fee schedule/contracted rate (contractual adjustment)
45.fix: Normally a write-off, BUT compare paid rate vs contract - this code hides underpayments. Flag for underpayment audit.

50.fix: Appeal with clinical documentation: treatment plan, progress notes, medical necessity letter. High value in behavioral health.

96.fix: Check plan benefits & RARC. If service IS covered (common payer error on BH telehealth), appeal with plan language.

97.desc: Payment included in allowance for another service (bundled)
97.fix: If separately payable, appeal with correct modifier (59/25) and documentation of distinct service.

109.desc: Claim not covered by this payer/contractor
109.fix: Identify correct payer (check member ID/plan), submit there. Watch the correct payer's timely filing clock!

151.fix: Appeal with documentation of medical necessity for frequency (common for BH visit limits), or verify units billed correctly.

197.fix: Request retro-authorization where payer allows; appeal with clinical necessity + any auth reference numbers. Often affects a whole string of visits - fix once, rebill all.

198.fix: Obtain additional units authorization; appeal affected visits with clinical justification.

204.desc: Service not covered under current benefit plan
204.fix: Verify against actual plan documents; payers misapply this to telehealth/BH parity. Appeal citing parity laws where applicable.

226.desc: Information requested from billing provider not received
226.fix: Send the requested records ASAP - this is money waiting on paperwork.

227.desc: Information requested from patient not received
227.fix: Contact patient to complete payer questionnaire (accident/COB forms), then resubmit.

242.desc: Services not provided by network/primary care providers
242.fix: If provider IS in network: appeal with contract/roster evidence (common after payer roster errors). If truly OON, check OON benefits.

252.fix: Submit the requested documentation. Fastest recoveries in the book.

B7.desc: Provider not certified/eligible to be paid for this service on this date
B7.fix: Credentialing/enrollment gap. Fix enrollment or bill under supervising provider per payer rules, then rebill EVERY affected claim - these come in expensive strings.

A1.fix: Meaningless alone - the RARC carries the real reason. Classify by RARC.
